svg.title: 客户服务与运营平台 · 客服协同、知识服务与运营治理的微服务平台
svg.desc: 按接入、领域服务、执行引擎、数据与外部能力分层；工单主链路与知识检索链路分开，客户运营和质量服务横向复用统一上下文。 工单采用 Activiti，知识检索采用 Elasticsearch；其余细化组件为结合业务场景的推荐选型。；工作台与渠道接入：Unified Workbench，TypeScript / React，Tasks / Knowledge / Operations；Platform API Gateway，Spring Cloud Gateway，Tenant Scope / Access Policy，Channel API / WeCom Adapter；平台领域服务：Work Order Service，Spring Boot / OpenFeign，Business State / Process Link，Assignment / SLA / History；Knowledge Service，Spring Boot / MyBatis-Plus，Publication / Search API，Index Change Events；Customer & SCRM Service，Customer Profile / Tags，WeCom Operations，Ownership / Handover；Quality & Operations，Automated Check / Human Review，Service Metrics / Policies，Summary / Tagging Tasks；流程、检索与智能执行：Activiti BPMN Engine，Process Definition / Instance，User Tasks / Timers，Runtime / History；Elasticsearch，Full-text Index / Filters，Relevance Ranking，Published Knowledge Search；AI & RPA Orchestrator，Structured Outputs / Task Dispatch，Model API / RPA Adapter，Reviewable Results；业务数据与事件：Platform Data Store，MySQL / Tenant Scope，Tickets / Knowledge / Profiles，Process / Audit Records；Domain Event Bus，RabbitMQ，Publication / Index Updates，Task Results / Notifications；Model & Automation APIs，Model Gateway / RPA Runtime，External Capabilities，Invocation Results；01 Unified Workbench ↔ Platform API Gateway：管理操作与任务处理；02 Platform API Gateway ↔ Work Order Service：工单受理与办理；03 Platform API Gateway ↔ Knowledge Service：内容维护与话术查询；04 Platform API Gateway ↔ Customer & SCRM Service：客户资料与企微运营；05 Platform API Gateway ↔ Quality & Operations：质量复核与运营配置；06 Work Order Service ↔ Activiti BPMN Engine：流程实例与任务操作；07 Knowledge Service ↔ Elasticsearch：检索请求与搜索结果；08 Quality & Operations ↔ AI & RPA Orchestrator：小结、打标与初检任务；09 Customer & SCRM Service ↔ Platform Data Store：客户资产与跟进记录；10 Activiti BPMN Engine ↔ Platform Data Store：流程运行与历史记录；11 Knowledge Service ↔ Platform Data Store：知识内容与发布状态；12 Knowledge Service → Domain Event Bus：知识发布变更事件；13 Domain Event Bus → Elasticsearch：异步索引更新；14 AI & RPA Orchestrator ↔ Model & Automation APIs：模型与自动化调用；15 AI & RPA Orchestrator → Domain Event Bus：任务结果与后续处理；16 Work Order Service ↔ Platform Data Store：工单业务记录
